SELECT
    'BCR' as TestBanca,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.Nume)                  AS [Numar OP],

    CAST(s.Suma AS DECIMAL(18,2))                        AS [Suma],

    s.Cont                                               AS [IBAN Beneficiar],

    SUBSTRING(s.Cont,5,4)                                AS [Banca Beneficiar],

    s.Nume                                               AS [Nume Beneficiar],

    s.CNP                                                AS [Cod fiscal beneficiar],

    s.TipPlata                                           AS [Detalii 1],

    NULL                                                 AS [Detalii 2],

    'RON'                                                AS [Valuta (RON)],

    NULL                                                 AS [Plata buget],

    '[GetOrSession:Branch]'                              AS [Nume platitor],

    bc.IBANPlatitor                                      AS [IBAN Platitor],

    SUBSTRING(s.Cont,5,4)                                AS [Banca platitor],

    bc.CodFiscalPlatitor                                 AS [Cod fiscal platitor]

FROM app.SumaBCR s

INNER JOIN app.BancaCard bc
    ON bc.CodBanca= @CodBanca

WHERE s.CodSucursala = @CodSucursala
  AND s.Anul         = @Anul
  AND s.Luna         = @Luna
  AND s.TipPlata     = @TipPlata
  AND CAST(s.DataPlatii AS DATE) = CAST(@DataPlatii AS DATE)
   


ORDER BY
    s.Nume;

SELECT

     SUBSTRING(bc.IBANPlatitor ,5,4)                     AS [Banca Platitor (CECE)],

    bc.IBANPlatitor                                      AS [IBAN Platitor],
    
    bc.NumePlatitor                                      AS [Nume platitor],

    SUBSTRING(s.Cont,5,4)                                AS [Banca platitor],

    bc.CodFiscalPlatitor                                 AS [Cod fiscal platitor],

    NULL                                                 AS [Strada platitor],
    
    NULL                                                 AS [Oras platitor],
    
    SUBSTRING(s.Cont,5,4)                                AS [Cod BIC banca beneficiar],
    
    s.Cont                                               AS [IBAN Beneficiar],
    
    s.Nume                                               AS [Nume Beneficiar],
    
    NULL                                                 AS [Nume Banca Beneficiara],

    NULL                                                 AS [Sucursala Banca Beneficiar],

    NULL                                                 AS [E-mail beneficiar],

    NULL                                                 AS [Cod fiscal],

    s.CNP                                                AS [Cod fiscal beneficiar],
    
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.Nume)                  AS [Numar OP],

    FORMAT(CAST(s.DataPlatii AS DATE), 'yyddMM')               AS  [Data] ,    

    'RON'                                                AS [Valuta (RON)],
    
    CAST(s.Suma AS DECIMAL(18,2))                        AS [Suma],

    s.TipPlata                                           AS [Detalii 1],
    
    NULL                                                 AS [Detalii 2],
    
    NULL                                                 AS [Detalii 3],
    
    NULL                                                 AS [Detalii 4],
    
    NULL                                                 AS [Urgent],
    
    NULL                                                 AS [Plata Buget]

FROM app.SumaCEC s

INNER JOIN app.BancaCard bc
    ON bc.CodBanca = @CodBanca

WHERE s.CodSucursala = @CodSucursala
  AND s.Anul         = @Anul
  AND s.Luna         = @Luna
  AND s.TipPlata     = @TipPlata
  AND CAST(s.DataPlatii AS DATE) = CAST(@DataPlatii AS DATE)

ORDER BY
    s.Nume;
